why_existing_data_stop: Species-level/public tips cannot assign standing ancestral variation vs introgression vs lineage-specific change in unsampled morph populations.
minimum_new_data: Same-individual standardized capitulum phenotype + nuclear population ancestry + plastid haplotype + flow-cytometry cytotype.
core_systems: C. brevicaule; C. irumtiense; C. pendulum; C. sieboldii
minimum_scale: core190: brevicaule60; irumtiense60; pendulum40; sieboldii30; add lineare16+dipsacolepis16 only after core replication is protected
collect_now: DNA leaf; voucher-linked phenotype; colour/UV; orientation; direct phyllary/spine measurements; plastid companion; fresh-leaf cytotype material
do_not_expand_yet: Japan38 same-library RAD sensitivity; broad continental expansion; heavy 294-296 rebuild
decision_after_data: Discriminate standing variation, introgression/gene flow, and lineage-specific origin in at least two independent focal systems.

why_existing_data_stop: A narrow experimental meta-analysis now quantifies a large Cirsium antagonist seed-output cost (RR 2.674 under reduced herbivory; equivalent ambient loss 62.6%), but existing data do not identify which focal capitulum module causes protection or its pollination/abiotic trade-off.
minimum_new_data: Ancestry-linked functional measurements and manipulation: orientation first; W/coloured second; phyllary/spine only after botanical validation; quantify antagonist access/damage, effective pollination and reproductive fitness on the same experimental units.
core_systems: Ryukyu focal populations first; mainland W/C replicate second
minimum_scale: orientation feasibility pilot about 10 experimental units per treatment per population where feasible; final replication from pilot variance and treatment loss
collect_now: Natural/achieved orientation; rain/wetting; pollen condition/viability; visitor guild; effective contact; florivory; seed-predator damage; total/filled achenes; plant-level seasonal display and predation
do_not_expand_yet: repeating generic insect-exclusion studies without a focal trait; large phyllary/spine manipulation before validation; stickiness as a core experiment; broad heterogeneous interaction pooling
decision_after_data: Demonstrate which focal module changes antagonist cost and/or pollination/protection, with a replicated trait -> pathway -> reproductive-fitness link.

why_existing_data_stop: Public homology and young-leaf RNA only support pathway-retention plausibility; they cannot identify floral regulation or causation.
minimum_new_data: Same-individual ancestry + coding/regulatory haplotype + floral-stage RNA + pigment chemistry + calibrated colour phenotype.
core_systems: C. brevicaule/C. irumtiense; C. pendulum or C. sieboldii replicate; takaoense as anchor
minimum_scale: at least 2 independent W/C transitions; target 2-3 populations per state where feasible and 6-10 biological individuals per population/state for expression/pigment work
collect_now: Collect floral tissue at late bud/pigmentation onset and fresh pre-anthesis/anthesis; separate pigment tissue; immutable sample IDs linked to Aim1 ancestry and phenotype
do_not_expand_yet: 3-5 extra transition systems before two core systems are resolved; more public BLAST/SRA fishing as a substitute for floral data
decision_after_data: Resolve whether retained pathway plus regulatory/expression change recurs across at least two independent W/C transitions.
